description: Letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Alfred Stieglitz sent from New Mexico. Enclosed are photographs of Georgia O'Keeffe's paintings of Black Place I (CR1080), Black Place III (CR1082), and Pelvis I (CR1075).
imageCaption: Letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Alfred Stieglitz, 1944-07-06. Letters to Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. © Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe to Alfred Stieglitz, with enclosed photographs
